question: Which city of India is set to establish India’s first Integrated Waste Management City cum-Learning Centre by September 2025, aiming to create a garbage-free environment?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gorakhpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gorakhpur**, a city in the Indian state of **Uttar Pradesh**, is set to establish India’s first **Integrated Waste Management City cum-Learning Centre** by **September 2025**.
 
• The initiative aims to create a **garbage-free environment** by managing waste effectively and educating the public about sustainable waste management practices.
 
• This project is aligned with India’s national goals of promoting **sustainability** and ensuring **environmental conservation**.
 
• The facility will serve as a **learning hub** for students, professionals, and the general public to understand the importance of **integrated waste management**.
 
• **Technologies** for waste segregation, recycling, and energy recovery are likely to be incorporated into the center to ensure effective waste management.
 
• This project reflects the commitment of **local governance** and stakeholders to address the issue of urban waste management innovatively and efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Moradabad**__

 __
 
• **Moradabad**, located in **Uttar Pradesh**, is known as the **"Brass City of India"** due to its prominent brass handicrafts industry.
 
• The city has not been highlighted for any specific integrated waste management projects as of now.
 
 
 
• **Kanpur**__
 __
 
• **Kanpur** is a major industrial city in Uttar Pradesh, recognized for its **leather and textile industries**.
 
• While Kanpur has faced challenges related to **industrial pollution** and waste management, it is not the location of the first Integrated Waste Management City.
 
 
 
• **Agra**__
 
 
• **Agra**, famously known for the **Taj Mahal**, is a major tourist destination in India.
 
• The city has undertaken initiatives for **solid waste management** but is not the site for the first Integrated Waste Management City.
